acceptance.requirement: One versioned stageProfiles authority defines all eight required roles with capability digest, model, effort, sandbox, write scope, required Skill digests, and rationale codes.
Root is exactly Sol/low and cannot author DAG semantics; DAG creation/update is exactly fresh Sol/max/read-only and root-launched after remote snapshot drift.
The same Sol/max testOwnerId freezes tests and independently verifies behavior without implementation write authority or implementer context inheritance.
Code and UI/UX implementers remain Sol/low, own the full same-attempt self-test loop, modify only implementation paths, and cannot sign behavior or UX acceptance.
UI and UX implementation have one Sol/low owner with required design Skill digests; UX acceptance is separate Sol/max/read-only and cannot implement.
Documentation starts only after behavior green and, for UI work, UX accepted; Luna/xhigh is used only with a matching capability receipt and fallback is explicit.
Group continuity preserves the exact member stage profile and receipt; it cannot upgrade effort, accumulate permissions, share verifier context, or replace member metadata.
Legacy implementer/reviewer aliases, single-node model/effort, implementationProfile, and reviewProfile have no authority or fallback.
